$comment: Template only — every value below is a placeholder. Real secrets belong in environment variables (Railway variables, a .env consumed by dotnet-user-secrets locally, etc.), never in this file. Kept committed, per the project's own .gitignore, so the SHAPE of required config is documented somewhere other than reading Program.cs line by line.

ConnectionStrings.$comment: Program.cs falls back to the DATABASE_URL env var if this is absent, and accepts either a Postgres keyword string or a postgres:// URI (Railway's format) — see ToNpgsqlKeywordFormat in Program.cs.

$required_env_vars.$comment: Everything below this point is read from IConfiguration but is NOT meant to live in this file in a real deployment — set these as actual environment variables. Listed here only so the full set is visible in one place. Remove this whole '$required_env_vars' block once you've set the real vars; it is not read by the app (unknown keys are simply ignored by the config binder).
$required_env_vars.JWT_SECRET: REQUIRED — Program.cs throws at boot if unset. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 64
$required_env_vars.JWT_REFRESH_EXPIRY: optional — defaults to 7 days. Accepts a bare integer (seconds) or a suffixed value: 15m, 12h, 7d, 30s
$required_env_vars.ENCRYPTION_KEY: REQUIRED in production (fatal boot error if missing — see CryptoService.AssertKeyAtBoot). Encrypts bank account, cheque, and Razorpay secret fields at rest. Must be exactly 64 hex chars (32 bytes). Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
$required_env_vars.CORS_ORIGINS: REQUIRED in production (Program.cs throws at boot if unset outside Development). Comma-separated list of allowed origins, e.g. https://app.yourschool.com,https://yourschool.com
$required_env_vars.DATABASE_URL: Fallback for ConnectionStrings:Postgres above — Railway injects this automatically. Set one or the other, not necessarily both.
$required_env_vars.REDIS_URL: Optional. Used only for the JWT revocation blacklist and rate limiting. Without it, both fall back to per-instance in-memory storage — fine on a single Railway instance, NOT safe once you scale to more than one.
$required_env_vars.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Required only if a school has Razorpay online payments enabled — verifies the HMAC signature on incoming webhook calls (see WebhookController). Per-school Razorpay API keys themselves live encrypted in the School table, not here.
$required_env_vars.Seed__SuperAdminUsername: Optional — defaults to "superadmin". Note the DOUBLE underscore: .NET's env-var config provider maps Seed__X to the IConfiguration key Seed:X.
$required_env_vars.Seed__SuperAdminPassword: REQUIRED on first boot of a fresh database — with no existing superadmin and this unset, the seeder logs an error and does not create one (deliberately no default password in production).
$required_env_vars.Rescue__Username: Break-glass only. Leave UNSET. Setting this + Rescue__Password resets that user's password and revokes all their sessions on every boot while set — set it, redeploy once, then UNSET both immediately.
$required_env_vars.SEED_DEMO_DATA: Optional boolean. true seeds a demo school with sample data (DatabaseSeeder.SeedDemoAsync) — for a staging/demo environment only, never production.
